payload.text: In December 2023, the World Bank approved the Nigeria Distributed Access through Renewable Energy Scale-up (DARES) project with $750 million in IDA financing.

evidence_refs.effective_claim: The World Bank approved the Nigeria Distributed Access through Renewable Energy Scale-up (DARES) project in December 2023, financed by an IDA credit of $750 million, designed to provide new or improved electricity access to over 17.5 million Nigerians through distributed renewable energy solutions.
evidence_refs.source_title: Nigeria to Expand Access to Clean Energy for 17.5 Million ...
evidence_refs.excerpt: The World Bank today approved the Nigeria Distributed Access through Renewable Energy Scale-up (DARES) project, which is financed by an International Development Association\* (IDA) credit of $750 million and will leverage over $1 billion of private capital and significant parallel financing from development partners, including $100 million from the Global Energy Alliance for People and Planet and $200 million from Japan International Cooperation Agency.

review.note: Approved for canonical promotion scope: World Bank approval of DARES and $750 million IDA financing. The 17.5 million access objective is not included in this canonical claim.

creation_provenance.note: Human-controlled promotion of approved World Bank evidence covering DARES approval and $750 million IDA financing.

review_provenance.note: Reviewed against the completed Nigeria market scan and the approved World Bank evidence supporting DARES approval and $750 million IDA financing.
